Resolves #20267

Evidence: E1 — `npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs` (`19 passed (433ms)`)

## Summary

Gates Turbo-Mode (`autoInitRecords: false`) soft hydration in `Neo.data.Store#filter` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`) and `Neo.data.Store#isFilteredItem` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`) on `Filter#effective` instead of `!f.disabled && f.value !== null`:

- **`Store#filter` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`):** Selects `activeFilters` via `me.filters.filter(f => f.effective)`.
- **`Store#isFilteredItem` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`):** Gates per-item soft hydration via `if (filter.effective)`.
- **Unit spec (`test/playwright/unit/data/Store.spec.mjs`):** Verifies that in a Turbo-Mode `Store` with a calculated model field (`doubled`), an enabled `filterBy` filter declaring `fields: ['doubled']` without a `value` soft-hydrates `doubled` on raw items during both `Store#filter()` and `Store#isFilteredItem(rawItem)`.

## AC Evidence

|---|---|---|
| `Store#filter` (`src/data/Store.mjs:732`) selects `activeFilters` using `f => f.effective` | `src/data/Store.mjs` line 732 | `activeFilters = me.filters.filter(f => f.effective)` |
| `Store#isFilteredItem` (`src/data/Store.mjs:1114`) gates per-item soft hydration using `if (filter.effective)` | `src/data/Store.mjs` line 1114 | `if (filter.effective)` |

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — two gates move onto an existing source of truth (`Filter#effective`), plus one spec. It mirrors #20259 in `TreeStore` and adds no new concept.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** `Store#filter` and `Store#isFilteredItem` now choose which filters to soft-hydrate with `Filter#effective` instead of the pre-#19792 `!disabled && value !== null`. I checked the gate against what actually evaluates. `Filter#decide` (`src/collection/Filter.mjs` L228–243) reads the item only for an enabled filter with a `filterBy` or a non-empty value, and that set is exactly `effective` (L115–118). So hydration now covers every filter that reads a field, and nothing else. The same alignment also fixes a second case: a value filter for `null` with `includeEmptyValues: false` evaluates but was never hydrated. Red-first, in a worktree with the base source (`bc8706f94e`) and the head spec, the new test fails at `count` (2, expected 1). With only the `filter()` gate fixed, it fails at `rawKept.doubled` (`undefined`, expected 30), so each arm guards its own gate. CI at `ea91317724`: 52 pass, 1 skipping (`automerge`). Bounded repair: I swept `src/data`, `src/collection` and `src/grid` for the old predicate with a fixed string, and the control finds both old gates on base. The only hit at head is `TreeStore.mjs:612`, because this branch predates #20259; on `dev` it already reads `effective`, and the two PRs share no file.
